column1: # Gold speaker labels for the scene in neoreader-epub-shape.tsv, one sentence per row.
# The trace is what the host *sends* — clauses, split at commas, with leading spaces. This
# is what the book *says* — whole sentences, which is the unit the index stores. Pairing
# the two is what makes the vertical slice checkable without a device: build an index from
# this file, replay the trace against it, and every chunk should resolve to the right voice.
# Same repo-authored prose as the trace, so nothing here comes from a real book (CLAUDE.md §8).

column2: The rain had not let up since morning.
Sarah crossed to the window, moving slowly, and stood there a while without saying anything at all.
Thomas did not turn from the desk.
You have been avoiding the letter, she said.
The clock in the hall struck four, and none of them moved.
